item.description: Actor Jim Sarbh will narrate an upcoming documentary titled Unani Ki Kahaani, produced in collaboration with Hamdard Laboratories. item.title: Emotion, assurance and EMIs: The first-time homebuyer mindset in India
item.description: For a first-time homebuyer in India, purchasing a house is never just a financial transaction. It is an emotional milestone, a social signal, and a long-term promise rolled into one. It is the moment when rent receipts turn into ownership papers, when hesitation is replaced by permanence, and when a monthly EMI becomes a symbol of progress rather than pressure. item.title: Why brand value still feels optional in India
item.description: Consider Apple. The iPhone is priced far above most smartphones, not because its components are radically different, but because the Apple brand carries meaning. That meaning shows up as trust, aspiration and loyalty, and ultimately as pricing power and long-term value. This invisible premium people are willing to pay is brand value.
